name: tradrl-adapters-broker
description: The broker execution adapter (W065) — the provider-neutral SHADOW broker vocabulary (the tradrl-adapters/* flat source-exported layout, the W057 arena precedent). Spec: REQUIREMENTS.md R063 — 'Shadow/live separation is mandatory' + R070 'Provider-neutral adapters': the broker vocabulary (venue kinds, order kinds, time-in-force, execution-report kinds, observation kinds) is declared HERE and ONLY HERE, as closed sets with fail-closed validation. THE SHADOW LAW is STRUCTURAL: every order routes to a SHADOW execution path — the typed record vocabulary has NO live-transmission field at all; any declaration carrying a live-transmission-shaped member or URL-shaped value is refused LOUDLY naming R063 (packages/tradrl-adapters/broker/broker-identity.ts liveTransmissionViolations). Credentials appear ONLY as W060 secret references — typed handles re-proven through packages/security's own validateSecretReference with errors carried verbatim (THE REDACTION LAW rides there, never bypassed). Shadow fills are content-addressed records composed from an order + a market observation BOTH carried verbatim (A6 — a fill's price IS the observation's carried price; no invented prices). A9 throughout; A14: the adapter COMPOSES typed data — never live execution, no network code.
